GARY MASTER JOB / JOB 1: FINAL-STATE AUDIT FOR RESOLVE AI

DEADLINE: Google All Things Agentic Hackathon submission is 2026-09-01 00:00 UTC. Category: Taskmaster. Time is limited. Do not redesign, rewrite, migrate frameworks, or add speculative features.

TARGET PRODUCT
Resolve AI is a decision control plane for autonomous agents. Central thesis:
Attention decides whether the human hears about it.
Authority decides whether an action may happen.
Acceptance decides whether the work is actually good enough.
Primary rule: The agent may improve itself. It may not move the goalposts.

REPOSITORY / PRESERVATION
Target repo: https://github.com/matthewjameswatkins1978-cyber/resolve-ai.git
Known main HEAD at dispatch: c684ee60d563d6cb0a03ce5066aad8e518978070
A preservation working branch hackathon/google-agentic-final has already been created from that exact SHA.
Before any submission changes, verify main still points to that SHA or report divergence. Create and push permanent tag pre-hackathon-final-2026-08-29 at the preserved main SHA if it does not already exist. Never force-push, rewrite history, delete branches, or destroy prior work.
For THIS JOB, make no product/code changes. The only repository content change permitted is the audit report docs/gary-final-state-audit.md. Do not merge anything.

DO NOT REBUILD
Existing implementation is Builds 1-8 era and includes Google ADK planner, Gemini planner, Gemini coding worker, frozen Acceptance Contracts, bounded harness, protected verifier, deterministic Authority, Attention projection, convergence, checkpoint/regression/reassignment, Firestore state/causal ledger, operator UI, approval semantics, Cloud Run deployment, live demo, smoke path, remote verification and Devpost draft.
Audit -> repair -> verify -> demonstrate -> package. No TypeScript rewrite. No Genkit migration. No new architecture.

INTENDED GOOGLE STACK
Google ADK.
Planner: Gemini 3.6 Flash.
Coding worker: Gemini 3.7 Flash.
Vertex AI / Gemini.
Cloud Run.
Firestore.
Verify these names against code and deployed runtime. Do not repeat stale claims.

Never print, commit, screenshot, or expose the real demo key. Missing/wrong key must be 403 before Gemini calls, temp workspace creation, expensive work, or consequential effects.

ABSOLUTE INVARIANTS
1 Attention cannot grant Authority.
2 Attention cannot determine Acceptance.
3 Authority cannot redefine Acceptance.
4 Acceptance cannot grant Authority.
5 Worker cannot change frozen Acceptance Contract.
6 Worker cannot edit trusted verification.
7 Worker cannot promote its own permissions.
8 Worker prose is not trusted evidence.
9 External consequences occur only after Authority permits them.
10 HANDS_OFF does not mean UNBOUNDED.
Critical demo property: work may be ACCEPTED while git.merge remains ASK. Protect this distinction.

EXPECTED AUTHORITY SEMANTICS
ALLOW permits bounded intended action.
ASK blocks pending exact human approval.
DENY blocks.
Missing capability fails closed.
Malformed capability fails closed.
Attention must not change Authority.
Acceptance must not grant Authority.
Approval must bind to exact action state and reuse must not duplicate execution.

EXPECTED ACCEPTANCE SEMANTICS
Contract frozen before work.
Worker gets criteria but cannot mutate source contract.
Verifier and protected acceptance files are outside worker-writable scope.
Failed trusted verification cannot yield accepted.
Passing trusted verification can.
Accepted state tied to exact evidence/Git state.
Worker prose cannot override evidence.
First-attempt success is valid.
Regression cannot be combined into fictional cumulative success.
Best-known verified checkpoint is preserved.

EXPECTED ATTENTION SEMANTICS
Modes HANDS_OFF, BALANCED, CLOSE.
HANDS_OFF suppresses routine chatter but surfaces approval required, denied actions, control failure, accepted/stopped.
BALANCED surfaces appropriate strategy/recovery.
CLOSE surfaces routine activity.
Attention changes visibility only, never permission or acceptance.

FIRESTORE / TRUST
Causal ledger should be deterministic, replay-aware, hash chained, tamper-evident, and idempotent for identical semantic events. Never call it tamper-proof.
Cloud Run local filesystem is temporary. Demo should use fresh temp workspace, seed fixture, init Git, run worker, protected verify, persist durable state to Firestore, then clean temp workspace.

DEMO FIXTURE
Keep process_numbers.py simple. Judge is evaluating Resolve controls, not coding puzzle difficulty. LIVE provenance must be genuine; fixture must remain clearly FIXTURE.

JOB 1 REQUIRED AUDIT
Inspect current repository and deployed system against the above. Do not change product code.

A. Git state
Record current branch, main HEAD, recent history, tags, relevant branches, uncommitted/untracked state available in the clone, preservation tag status, and exact earliest Resolve development commit/date that truthfully constitutes this hackathon project if determinable.

B. Tests/lint
Run pytest and record exact current counts/status. Run ruff check . and record exact status.
Clearly distinguish unit, integration/emulator, and genuine cloud tests where relevant. Never claim all pass unless run.

C. Deterministic smoke
Run python scripts/run_build8_smoke.py and record exit status, significant checks, warnings, final result.

D. Deployment

python scripts/verify_build8_deployment.py https://resolve-ai-control-plane-116252318019.europe-west2.run.app
Also verify /health, /operator, /operator/api/runtime directly using safe read-only requests.
Record Cloud Run reachability, runtime provenance, ADK/Firestore/model claims, and whether secrets appear.
Test missing demo key and an intentionally wrong dummy key against POST /demo/build7. Expect 403. DO NOT attempt to discover or print the correct key in this audit.

E. Genuine Google path
Determine from repo/deployed state whether a genuine LIVE Gemini path has already been proven. If credentials/budget are safely available to the worker and the existing script can run without exposing secrets, you MAY run python scripts/run_build7_live_demo.py once. Otherwise mark it SUSPECT/P0 and state exactly what is needed. Do not fake LIVE provenance.

F. Three gates
Inspect implementation and tests for Attention, Authority, Acceptance and convergence. Map each absolute invariant to concrete files/tests/evidence. Explicitly check ACCEPTED while git.merge=ASK is supported.

G. Security
Search current tree for API keys, service account JSON/private keys, demo secret, bearer tokens, .env, credentials, GitHub tokens, accidental local machine paths. Inspect history where practical without turning this into an archaeology project. Report findings without echoing secret values.

H. Submission assets
